Terms of Service

Last updated 31 October 2026

By using ManaCaptions you agree to these terms. Please read them carefully.

Your account

You sign in with Google. You are responsible for activity on your account. You must be at least 13 years old.

Credits and payments

Credits are prepaid. 1 credit covers 1 started minute of video. Payments are processed by Razorpay. Credits do not expire and are not transferable.

Refunds

If a transcription fails, the credits used are returned to your wallet automatically. Purchased credits are otherwise non-refundable, except where required by law.

Your content

You keep all rights to your videos and captions. You must have the right to upload the content. Do not upload illegal, hateful or infringing material.

AI accuracy

Captions are generated by AI and may contain mistakes. Please review them before publishing.

Changes

We may update these terms. We will notify you of important changes.
